prior_result.residual: mask_1 remains failed on all goal/task0 and spatial/task5 identities, and clean retention is below frozen X-VLA clean success.

candidates.name: RIFA_XVLA
candidates.core_mechanism: A lightweight learned adapter conditions X-VLA action hidden states on missing-camera status, RL4IL imputed in-hand latent features, and reliability signals such as imputation donor dispersion, retrieval descriptor margin, and policy entropy.
candidates.why_targets_residual: RL4IL's local port helps on object/task0 but fails on goal/task0 and spatial/task5; RIFA keeps the VLA closed-loop action path while using RL4IL as a reliability-aware prior signal instead of replaying a retrieved open-loop demo.
candidates.base_preserving_initialization: All adapter residual projections initialize to zero and reliability gates initialize to prefer the frozen X-VLA path on clean inputs.
legal_deployment_inputs: RL4IL prior features computed from legal observations
candidates.low_compute_path: Freeze X-VLA; train only LoRA/adapter/gating parameters with batch size 1 and bounded accumulation.
candidates.key_ablation: Remove reliability conditioning while keeping the same adapter parameter count and imputed latent input.

candidates.name: CVLR_XVLA
candidates.expanded_name: Cross-View Latent Reconstruction Adapter for X-VLA
candidates.core_mechanism: Train a lightweight cross-view predictor from agent-view, language, and proprioception to reconstruct missing wrist-view visual latents and inject them into the X-VLA visual-token stream.
candidates.why_targets_residual: Directly attacks wrist-view absence on goal/task0 and spatial/task5 by reconstructing a missing-view latent rather than replaying an open-loop retrieved action.
candidates.base_preserving_initialization: Predicted-latent residual initialized to zero and clean-view bypass initialized on.
candidates.low_compute_path: Freeze X-VLA; train cross-view predictor plus a small token-injection adapter.
candidates.key_ablation: Use the predictor without dropout/reliability conditioning.
candidates.reason_not_selected: More invasive token-stream surgery and weaker direct use of the validated RL4IL prior residual than RIFA_XVLA.

selection_reason: RIFA_XVLA is the narrower learned method around the observed residual: it preserves the X-VLA closed-loop policy path, uses the validated RL4IL prior as a reliability-aware feature source, directly targets failed mask_1 goal/spatial cases, and has a cleaner low-compute adapter path than cross-view token reconstruction.
next_action: Preregister RIFA_XVLA Stage 0 before any Ours VLA training.
